import os
# Verify the test files are in place
for f in sorted(os.listdir('crucible_hidden')):
    path = os.path.join('crucible_hidden', f)
    print(f"{f}: {os.path.getsize(path)} bytes")
    
# Count tests
import ast
for f in ['test_m1.py', 'test_m2.py']:
    with open(f'crucible_hidden/{f}') as fh:
        tree = ast.parse(fh.read())
    funcs = [n.name for n in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name.startswith('test_')]
    print(f"\n{f} has {len(funcs)} test functions: {funcs}")
